defs.def: to say sth in a loud voice; to speak loudly/angrily to sb 大声说；叫；嚷；斥责；怒骂

ex.s: My friends checked and came back shouting, “Amy, you got the main role! ” Sure enough, my name was at the top.
ex.t: 我的朋友们查看后跑回来喊道："艾米，你拿到主角了！"果然，我的名字在最上面。

ex.s: They held hands, shouting and yelling into the sky.
ex.t: 他们手拉着手，对着天空大喊大叫。

ex.s: When he walked in, the boy shouted proudly, “Hey, that's my bus driver!”They went into a quiet corner and began reading together.
ex.t: 当他走进去时，男孩骄傲地喊道："嘿，那是我的校车司机！"他们走进一个安静的角落，开始一起读书。

ex.s: “Again, Daddy, again!” Jacky shouts as I throw him skywards and catch him on the way back down again.
ex.t: “再一次，爸爸，再一次！”杰基喊道，我把他扔向天空，在回来的路上又抓住了他。

ex.s: Success is not just about who can shout the loudest The world needs quieter people, too.
ex.t: 成功不仅仅关乎谁喊得最大声——这个世界也需要更安静的人。

ex.s: Then the softball coach shouted out, “Does anyone know CPR?”
ex.t: 然后垒球教练喊道： “有人知道心肺复苏术吗？”

ex.s: A few minutes later, when I landed the trick, my friends beat their boards loud, shouting: “ Safe!
ex.t: 几分钟后，当我成功完成那个技巧时，朋友们大声拍板，喊着：稳了！

ex.s: Jimmy "You're Jimmy's son?!" Bob shouted in surprise.
ex.t: 吉米“你是吉米的儿子？ ！“鲍勃惊讶地喊道。

ex.s: Come and help me dig her out!” shouted the soldier.
ex.t: '过来帮我把她挖出来！'那个士兵喊道。

ex.s: One person drives the sled, shouting to the dogs to encourage them.
ex.t: 一个人驾驶雪橇，向狗狗大喊大叫，鼓励他们。

defs.def: to make a loud noise 呼叫；喊叫

ex.s: I would have given it up if I had not heard my father's encouraging shouts to cheer me on.
ex.t: 要不是听到父亲那鼓励我、为我加油的喊声，我早就放弃了。

ex.s: We all stood up and started cheering and shouting.
ex.t: 我们都站起来，开始欢呼和喊叫。

defs.def: to buy drinks or food for sb in a bar, restaurant, etc. （在酒吧、餐厅等）请人喝饮料（或吃东西）
a loud cry of anger, fear, excitement, etc. （愤怒、害怕、激动等的）呼喊，喊叫声

ex.s: Some shout angrily, some are even in tears.
ex.t: 有人愤怒地大喊，有人甚至哭了起来。

defs.def: a person's turn to buy drinks 轮到某人请客（喝饮料）

chunks.cn: 喊叫 / 喊叫安全的 / 喊叫军人
